verdict: Micron's revenue rose 58% in a year to $5.82B as the memory recovery took hold, and although the core business was roughly break-even, a $622M tax benefit and a $200M patent-license gain lifted net income to $793M.

otherDetail: Interest income of $130M on Micron's cash pile, less $144M of interest expense and $7M of other non-operating expense — plus the $224M of other operating income described in the note under the chart, which includes a $200M patent cross-license gain: a net +$203M in this step; equity-method investments added a further $1M, shown in their own step.
follow100Note: Rows reconcile to $100 at this rounding; the $224M other operating income credit sits inside 'Other income' — see the note under the chart.

takeaways.title: The memory recovery arrives
takeaways.text: Revenue rose 58% from a year ago to $5.82B and gross margin swung from -33% to 19%, as pricing recovered from the 2023 glut. Gross profit also benefited from $382M of lower costs on selling inventory that had been written down earlier.

takeaways.title: A tax benefit made the bottom line
takeaways.text: Net income of $793M was far bigger than the $170M of pre-tax profit: Micron booked a $622M income-tax benefit after switching to an estimated annual effective tax rate applied to year-to-date results, as its 10-Q explains.

takeaways.title: A patent deal padded the quarter
takeaways.text: Other operating income of $224M included a $200M gain from a patent cross-license agreement. Setting that gain and the tax benefit aside, the core memory business was roughly break-even — reported operating income was $191M.

footerNote: Business units are shown as originally reported for fiscal 2024 — Compute and Networking, Mobile, Embedded, and Storage (Q2 FY24 Form 10-Q segment note; operating margins are from that note) — because no SEC filing reports this quarter on the recast structure Micron adopted in fiscal 2026 (Cloud Memory, Core Data Center, Mobile and Client, Automotive and Embedded). On the recast basis Micron has filed only full-year FY24 unit revenue and the FQ4-24 quarter, so no quarterly recast split of FQ2-24 exists. Reported operating income was $191M; Micron's $224M 'Other operating (income) expense, net' line was income this quarter — it includes a $200M patent cross-license gain — so the chart shows it in the other-income step rather than as a negative expense: chart operating income is therefore -$33M, with net income unchanged at $793M. The $622M tax line was a benefit this quarter, so it is drawn as money in, not a tax bill.
